_comment: The single source of the brand's colours. branding/make_icon.py draws every icon from these, ui/theme/Theme.kt (the Brand object) mirrors them for the screens, res/values/colors.xml mirrors them for the window, and tools/gates/brand_tokens.py fails the build if any of them disagree.
why_violet: Rendered beside the agents this app hosts, the home-screen row is Codex (dark), Claude (terracotta), Antigravity (multicolour arch) and VS Code (blue). Violet is the slot none of them occupy. Black, the obvious choice for a developer tool, is the one colour that would vanish between Codex and Cursor.
